# Positioning

For workshops whose machine is standing still, against the three-week lead time of the
original manufacturer, on delivery in two days.

## The difference

Speed. Evidence: median time from order to dispatch over the last twelve months is 1.8
working days, measured from the order export in `daten/`.

## Words

- Words we use: regrinding, lead time, standstill.
- Words the market uses that we avoid: "premium", because every supplier here claims it.
